title: Make forged completion-ready hint controls discriminate original identity refusals
outcome: Each forged requester or runner identity is refused for its identity mismatch in a behavioral test, even when duplicate scheduling would otherwise mask removal of that guard.
acceptance: Fault cases exercise an unscheduled original or assert their specific identity-refusal outcome so removing the requester descriptor or runner-match guard makes the corresponding test fail; a genuine positive control still schedules the exact original, with no fabricated completion or credit.
